name: Danna-sama ga 7-nin iru!?
source:
You are working as a freelancer designer. Your job is going well so far, but you don’t have a hot boyfriend yet. Feeling sad, you make a wish on a shooting star…

The following morning, you wake up in a gorgeous castle-like house! You’ve became the wife of seven gorgeous celebrities! You may not be able to fall asleep because their burning love towards you is just too hot!

Start living with them and find out the reason why they press you to choose one of them…make your day special with your ideal husband♪
